title: Pictures with Kittens (hard version)
explanation: dp over (reposts used, last reposted picture). The transition takes a max over a window of the previous layer → monotonic deque, O(n·x).
traps: Unreachable states must be −∞, and the answer must take the last repost within the final k pictures.

extraLayers.prompt: What should the DP state represent?

options.text: dp[j][i] = max beauty using exactly j reposts, the last one being picture i
dp[i] = max beauty for the first i pictures
options.why: Loses how many reposts have been used (must be exactly x).

options.text: dp[j][i] = max beauty using j reposts among the first i pictures
options.why: Loses where the last repost is, which the 'every k consecutive' rule needs.

extraLayers.explanation: The window rule only cares about the gap to the previous repost, so remember the last repost position.

extraLayers.prompt: Given that state, which transition is right?

options.text: dp[j][i] = a_i + max over p ∈ [i−k, i−1] of dp[j−1][p], with the window max maintained by a monotonic deque
dp[j][i] = a_i + max over all p < i of dp[j−1][p]
options.why: Allows gaps of k or more pictures without a repost.

options.text: Same window max, computed by a loop over the window
options.why: Correct, but O(n²x) — that's the easy version F1.

extraLayers.explanation: Sliding-window maximum of the previous layer turns O(n·k) per layer into O(n).
